note: Treasure kit (synced via TREASURE_SYNERGY_IDS moran:200); Prydwen review (Bossing SSS) corroborates the CDR read: 'she now becomes a CDR, with her Burst Skill CD reduced to 20 seconds'. FERVOR ('Activates when Raptures appear: Cooldown of Burst Skill ▼ 20 sec continuously') is ALWAYS active in solo raids -> burstCdr 20 on her own burstCast, turning her 40s CD into an effective 20s so she bursts every rotation. S1 47.18% per-5-hits proc: the kit gates it 'while weapon is changed' (= her burst weapon-swap window), encoded with the swapGate:'swapped' primitive (src/skills/types.ts `swapGate?: 'swapped' | 'unswapped'`; the swap-gate check in the block-dispatch gate chain), which fires it inside [burstCast, +10s]. The gate matters because she is Burst I: her swap opens at her OWN cast, BEFORE the Full Burst window opens (the B1->B2->B3 chain must finish first), so the swap and FB windows are OFFSET — 3 rider hits land pre-FB at 4.70/5.12/5.53s while FB opens at 5.73s. S2 team burst-CDR 7.48s on full-burst entry is unconditional in practice (its Fervor precondition is always on) and is REQUIRED by two measured rotations: run-B (16.4s, with moran effective CD 40-20-7.48 = 12.5s) and TB2T2 (40s, cinderella 40-7.48 = 32.5s effective). BURST: weaponSwap 14.7%/shot AR + unlimited ammo, 10s, plus team ATK 42.57% of HER ATK (casterAtkPct). Her ally-side Damage Taken ▼35.14% is kept for fidelity and is INERT: the engine reads damageTakenPct only off the boss's buff list, never off a unit's, so an ally-targeted entry can never scale damage (the sign-and-target inversion trap this dodges is the boss-targeted encoding). Skipped as defensive: DEF-per-HP-lost, taunts, Perseverance max-HP phases, lifesteal. SWAP CADENCE (MEASURED 2026-07-17, moran control.mov 60fps frame read): base AR 12/s. Her burst prose states NO fire-rate change, only per-shot damage; normal fire pre-burst reads ~12/s off muzzle flashes + tracers, and the swap window reads ~10-14/s off popup density (the swap's Electric muzzle effect only LOOKS busier). No pullsPerSec override — base 12/s is faithful. A 24/s reading (from an unlabeled skill_value integer with no prose support) was board-REFUTED and must not be re-tried; the full evidence trail is DECISIONS 2026-07-17. ⚑ COLD RESIDUAL (footage-blocked; tier MEASURED-throughput): her 0.66-0.77 is NOT a per-shot value error — her measured per-shot popup reconciles to the standard formula to 0.3% (recon non-crit-non-core 30,478 = 14.71% x 131,441 crown-buffed ATK x 1.5723 helm dmgUp), so the coefficient is faithfully 14.7% of final ATK. The gap is THROUGHPUT: sim 217M vs real 288M at a matching per-shot value ⇒ real lands ~1.3x more hits than the sim's ~2100 (~2800), concentrated in the swap window (~1.5x there). Mechanism is either a faster swap fire-rate or the swap weapon firing >1 bullet/pull, and bullets-per-pull is NOT measurable from a COMP recording (muzzle bloom + occluded ammo counter + overlapping popups). RECIPE: an isolated moran-solo recording, or the datamined shot_count/muzzle_count for swap weapon 1028102. Do NOT model it as a per-shot value change (measured-refuted). PERSEVERANCE: her S2 'Max HP ▲ 91%/69.84%/51.09% for 3 sec (once per battle)' lines are unmodeled by design — HP-loss-gated ('Activates when HP falls below 20%'), so against the immortal partless boss they never fire, and they are self-targeted survival buffs with no atkOfMaxHpPct consumer on her, so they would be offensively inert even if they did. CRIT: the S1 rider leaves crit unset deliberately — the flatDamage effect handler defaults to crit-eligible (`crit: e.crit !== false`), matching the dominant repo convention, so the blank field is behaviourally identical to an explicit crit:true.

skill1: Activates at the start of battle. Affects self. DEF ▲ 3.51% continuously for every 1% of HP lost.
skill2: Activates when firing the final bullet. Affects the 3 enemy unit(s) with the highest final ATK. Taunts for 4 sec.
Activates when HP falls below 20%. Affects self. Effects vary according to the number of uses. Perseverance: Only one effect is triggered at a time.
Once: Max HP ▲ 91% for 3 sec. Activates once per battle.
Twice: Max HP ▲ 69.84% for 3 sec. Activates once per battle.
Three Times: Max HP ▲ 51.09% for 3 sec. Activates once per battle.
burst: Recovers 36.14% of attack damage as HP over 10 sec.
Attract: Taunts all enemies for 10 sec.
Note: Unable to take cover while using Burst Skill.
DEF ▲ 14.85% of the skill user's DEF for 10 sec.

caveats: ⚑ RECOVERY-EVENT SHAPE (checked 2026-08-10, phase-4 batch 4 — no change needed): her burst's 'Recovers 36.14% of attack damage as HP for 10 sec' is unmodeled as an HP magnitude (correct — no HP pool) and emits no recovery EVENT. Verified board-INERT rather than assumed: the lifesteal is SELF-scoped, the engine's heal effect fires recovery only at the block's own targets, and a 'recovery'-triggered consumer fires only when ITS unit receives one — so a self-lifesteal can never reach the crown-class ally consumer she shares the N9 comp with. A probe adding a shotFired+swapGate self-heal emit to her burst moved the board by exactly zero. Emitting it would still be more faithful (a future self-scoped on-recovery consumer would see it), so this is a consistency item, not a fit item: roster-wide, 8 of the 13 'Recovers X% of attack damage as HP' carriers emit and 5 (incl. her) do not. Wants one roster-wide ruling, not a unit-local fix.
⚑ swap throughput (see the note's COLD RESIDUAL): footage-blocked, base AR 12/s measured; do not re-tune per-shot value (measured-refuted).
